bugs.summary: Allow for loops to accept language objects as sequence variables
bugs.creator: kevinushey

comments.creator: kevinushey
kevinushey
maechler
comments.text:
(In reply to Kevin Ushey from comment #0)
.....
> Perhaps related; I believe `lapply()` could also accept pairlists and
> language objects as-is, but those are currently coerced to R lists. That
> would still lead to an underlying implementation that iterates using indexes
> though, so I think the change for `for` loops would be more useful.

Honestly, I would hate us to add a feature that works with `for(x in <OBJ>) ..`
but fails with `lapply(<OBJ>, ...)` {and vapply; sapply would come for free}.

Apart from that I agree it would be nice to loop over language objects, indeed;
as I'm not a computer scientist, nor a real expert on the "dangers" of allowing that,  I am waiting for comments of such experts.
